description:
Start an autonomous Dark Factory pipeline. The pipeline runs in the background and executes a PLAN → EXECUTE → VERIFY cycle up to `max_iterations` times.

**Requires:** Dark Factory is enabled at startup (enabled by default; the dashboard setting applies when no explicit `PRISM_DARK_FACTORY_ENABLED=true|false` override is present).

**How it works:**
1. Call this tool with an objective (what to accomplish)
2. The pipeline is queued and executes autonomously in the background
3. Use `session_check_pipeline_status` to poll for results

**Safety:**
- Pipelines are scoped to a `working_directory` — no filesystem escape
- Strict iteration cap (default: 3) prevents infinite loops
- Wall-clock timeout (default: 15min) prevents runaway execution
- All operations are logged to the session ledger for audit

allowed_write_paths.description: Relative files Factory may change. Other context files remain read-only.

context_files.description: Optional list of specific files to focus on. Paths are relative to the working directory.

max_iterations.description: Maximum PLAN→EXECUTE→VERIFY loop iterations (default: 3, max: 10). Each iteration is one complete cycle. Most tasks complete in 1-2 iterations.

model_override.description: Optional model name to use instead of the default LLM. Useful for routing to a local model (e.g., 'qwen3') via Claw.

objective.description: What the pipeline should accomplish. Be specific — this becomes the LLM's system prompt objective.

project.description: Project identifier. Required for scoping and audit.

test_command.description: Caller-authorized verification command. Factory runs this without a shell and requires it to pass.

working_directory.description: Absolute path to the working directory. The pipeline can only modify files within this directory. Defaults to the project's repo_path if configured.

name: session_start_pipeline
